letter.lead: When we founded Solvent, eleven years ago, we had three rooftops, a borrowed windmill and more enthusiasm than money. Today we produce energy for more than eight thousand homes, shops and businesses in the county, and we do it without leaving it: what we generate here is consumed here.
paragraphs: 2025 has been the year of **consolidation**. We commissioned the Les Preses solar park, expanded the one at Sant Joan and repowered the three oldest wind turbines. We produced 11% more than the previous year and closed the year with a positive result for the fifth year in a row.

None of this is the work of one person. It is the result of the work of the twenty-three people on our staff, of the more than twelve hundred members who make the decisions in the assembly, and of a network of local suppliers who have installed every kilowatt with their hands and with good judgment.
This report tells what we have achieved, and also what it has cost us and what we still have to do. We invite you to read it with a critical eye: a cooperative improves by asking questions.
With warm regards and eager to keep going,

milestones.text: The assembly approves the 2024 accounts with 94% of the votes.
The 1.6 MWp Les Preses solar park is connected to the grid.
Repowering works on the three wind turbines are completed.
We reach customer number 8,000, a bakery in Sant Feliu.

in_figures.comment: Production follows the curve of the sun: from November to January it drops below 125 MWh, and between May and August it exceeds 250. Wind partly makes up for the winter, which is why adding a fourth wind turbine, planned for 2026, is one of our priorities.

customers.lead: A cooperative exists for those who use it. This year we served 8,412 customers, 46% of them households.
customers.community:
## Households

We added 412 households, most of them in Garrotxa villages that had no local supply offer. The **stable price** tariff held all year, including the winter months.

## Shops and businesses

A third of our non-residential customers are bakeries, workshops and small industries that cover part of their consumption with the solar installation we fitted on their roof.

## Energy communities

We supported the creation of **five local energy communities**, in which neighbors share the production of a single roof. Each one received free training and legal advice.

## Solidarity fund

One percent of our turnover goes to a fund that pays the bills of families in vulnerable situations: this year, 61 households.

results.investment_note: 100% of the investment was financed with contributions from members, with no debt to financial institutions.

environment.quote: Every kilowatt-hour we produce here is one that does not have to be brought from far away, or burned.

commitments.text: Exceed 2,700 MWh of production with the fourth wind turbine and the Les Preses expansion.
Cut the emissions of the maintenance vehicle fleet to zero; today it has two diesel vans.
Publish the carbon footprint of the whole supplier chain, with the help of the university.
Plant four thousand native trees on land provided by the town councils of the county.

governance.next_steps:
The **General Assembly** of March 21 approved these lines of work for the next fiscal year:

1. Open a customer service office in Olot, with afternoon hours.
2. Launch the time-of-use tariff for customers with an electric car.
3. Double the storage capacity of the community warehouse.

Members can propose items for the agenda one month in advance.
